semantics.browser_errors: R5 decisive browser-error fields and selected R4 console/page/error/request fields are preserved as recorded; no new interpretation is applied.
semantics.readiness: R5 material_ready_failure/objective counts and R5 final readiness fields are retained separately; a category count is not itself a final readiness verdict.
semantics.risk_ranking: R5 risk_ranking is inspection order only; it is not severity and not a Product-defect verdict.
semantics.scrolling_vs_horizontal: below_fold_controls_normal_scroll and vertical document dimensions are retained separately from body/document horizontal overflow fields. Ordinary below-fold vertical height is not counted as horizontal overflow or clipping.
